Count Wrongula - Album 1: WHO

The Tridecagon of Old

"We are the Tridecagon of Old"

[Gothic Rubato Intro]

Thirteen chairs Thirteen names Thirteen centuries Guarding ancient ways

One chair higher At the center of the hall

And one Count missing

Again

[Verse 1]

Three days should have brought him Three days on the road The candles are shorter Our patience is old

Amdis checks the doorway With irritation refined The others know the expression

Wrongula is late again

Two decades since the last time We called him to this room Two decades since we explained How vampires ought to move

Two decades

And apparently

He learned absolutely nothing

[Pre-Chorus]

Wrong Improper Unbecoming Strange

Every time we correct him He invents another change

No blood No crossing No hiding from the light

How can one vampire Be so consistently incorrect?

[Chorus]

We are the Tridecagon of Old Thirteen keepers of the blood Ancient law and ancient custom Standing where our elders stood

We are the Tridecagon of Old We remember what is right

And somewhere on a road tonight

Wrongula is probably Doing something wrong

[Verse 2]

Ambrosia remembers breakfast The scandal still survives Godfrey calls it sacrilege That somehow keeps him alive

Vlad questions all the mirrors Sapphira hates the sun Zeck cannot understand Why garlic hasn’t killed him once

Jezebel says pastries Should not constitute a meal Umbra wants an explanation For how reflection can be real

Horasio asks why chickens Exist upon his land

Asura says the entire thing Has gotten out of hand

Katherine blames indulgence Melchor blames his youth

Then everyone remembers

Wrongula is older than that excuse

[Pre-Chorus]

Food

Actual food

How does he survive?

No crossing for feeding Yet perfectly alive

He eats He sleeps He exercises at dawn

Every rule says something’s wrong

Yet somehow

He goes on

[Chorus]

We are the Tridecagon of Old Thirteen guardians of the ways Eight hundred years of council And considerably older days

We are the Tridecagon of Old Tradition written deep

And Count Wrongula keeps treating Every sacred rule as cheap

Sunlight Mirrors Breakfast

Bread

There are limits

Even for the undead

[Verse 3]

Then the laughter loses rhythm And the chamber settles down

Because there is another reason They summoned him to town

Three months

Only three

And crossing has grown thin

Paths that opened at a thought Now barely let them in

All thirteen crossed freely Wherever hunger called

No instinct needed No uncertain road No boundary at all

But lately something closes

Something pushes back

A door once always open Now narrowing to black

[Pre-Chorus]

Once a day

Then once a week

Then nothing when we tried

Thirteen ancient vampires Waiting on one side

The markets feel the pressure The lesser bloodlines starve

And no one understands What is happening to the paths

[Bridge]

Luchinda watches quietly Youngest in the room

Two hundred thirty-two Among relics dressed in gloom

She wasn’t here two decades ago When Wrongula last came

She knows the accusations

She has heard the name

No blood

No crossing

Sunlight on his skin

A reflection in the mirror

And somehow strength within

Everyone calls him defective Incorrect from fang to bone

But one question keeps returning

How has he survived alone?

[Theatrical Build]

Amdis wants correction

Ambrosia wants proof

Godfrey wants tradition

Vlad demands the truth

Sapphira wants an answer

Zeck wants him controlled

Jezebel wants dignity

From vampires young and old

Umbra wants the crossing fixed

Horasio wants supply

Asura wants to understand

Why pathways suddenly die

Katherine wants order

Melchor wants the same

Luchinda only wonders

What if Wrongula isn’t the problem?

[Final Chorus]

We are the Tridecagon of Old Thirteen voices, ancient blood

We have watched the ages change And stood exactly where we stood

We are the Tridecagon of Old And something has gone wrong

The crossings fade The markets strain The hungry won’t last long

And somewhere through the wilderness The Count we summoned comes

No blood No crossing No concern

Still thriving in the sun

We called him here to question Everything he chose

But now there is another question

One nobody quite knows

[Vamp Outro]

Thirteen chairs

Thirteen minds

One missing Count

And shrinking time

Amdis looks toward the doors

Luchinda watches him

Far beyond the council walls

Something in the world

Is closing
